What's new in Tuned 2.6.0

November 21, 2026

Tuned 2.6.0 is out: 4 new.

New

  • A click on a channel or show opens VLC or copies its link
  • Tuned's logo in the upper left on TV, slimmer side margins and dark by default
  • Send the log and device details from Logs with one press; no Report a problem on a TV
  • Keep films and episodes in the mini player
